title: Rotterdam Investment Priority Lab
summary: Compares policy investment priorities across Rotterdam's urban core on the official CBS 500 metre statistical grid.
question: Which Rotterdam grid cells remain high priorities across different public-investment perspectives?
interpretation: Compare five policy scenarios on the official CBS 500 metre grid. Scores are relative to the loaded urban-core extent. Confidence describes available weighted data separately from priority.
limitations: Scenario weights express policy choices, not an objectively correct funding ranking.
The pilot covers the urban core, not the whole municipality.
